extDescription.message: Passkeys from your keyward vault: sign in and save new ones with Touch ID

signInLead.message: $SITE$ asks for a passkey. Choose the account

createLead.message: $SITE$ wants to create a passkey. Choose where to keep it

createLeadUser.message: $SITE$ wants to create a passkey for $USER$. Choose where to keep it

lockedText.message: Unlock keyward, then press Try again

noKeyward.message: keyward did not answer: check that the app is running

unpairedText.message: Open keyward: it shows the same words. Compare them and pair, then press Try again.

pairExpired.message: These words have expired: press Try again for new ones

noneText.message: Sign in another way — the browser offers your other passkeys, a phone or a security key.
